metadata.description: Big Mama Burgers n' Fries premium animated landing page.
metadata.title: Big Mama | Burgers n' Fries

findings.finding: No canonical link is present in source HTML.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Add one self-referencing HTTPS canonical after approval.
findings.title: Canonical URL is absent

findings.finding: Production origin is unresolved, so deployable absolute sitemap URLs cannot be generated safely.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Create production robots.txt and sitemap.xml after approval.
findings.requiredDecision: Verify the public production origin and crawler policy.
findings.title: Production robots and sitemap are not ready

findings.recommendedProductionChange: Integrate validated Restaurant/WebSite/WebPage JSON-LD without rating, review, Offer, Product, FAQPage, or HowTo claims.
findings.requiredDecision: Approve verified Restaurant graph fields and production origin.
findings.title: No structured data is present

findings.finding: The visible mail link uses hello@bigmama.example at line 1084.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Replace or remove only the placeholder contact surface.
findings.requiredDecision: Provide a verified public email or approve removal of the email CTA.
findings.title: Placeholder public email is exposed

findings.finding: A 4.8 local rating claim is displayed at line 283; no authorized review dataset was available.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Do not add AggregateRating or Review schema until verified.
findings.requiredDecision: Provide platform, count, current rating, and evidence date, or remove the claim.
findings.title: Displayed 4.8 rating lacks approved evidence

findings.finding: Production origin, absolute social image URL, language strategy, verified public email, and Big Tokyo status remain setup-required.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Use verified values only in metadata, schema, hreflang, and public contact surfaces.
findings.title: Production identity decisions are unresolved

findings.finding: Loader timers occur at app.js lines 28 and 27; map initialization and external tiles occur at lines 450 and 471.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Audit-only recommendation: shorten non-functional loader gating and lazy-initialize the map.
findings.requiredDecision: Approve a separate website performance implementation scope.
findings.title: Initial UI and map work are deliberately delayed or eager

findings.finding: No Open Graph or Twitter metadata is present.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Add deterministic OG/Twitter metadata after approval.
findings.requiredDecision: Verify canonical origin and absolute social image.
findings.title: Social metadata is absent

findings.finding: The H1 is brand-led but does not name burgers or Nea Filadelfia.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Refine only the H1/supporting copy while preserving brand voice.
findings.title: Primary heading lacks explicit category and locality

findings.finding: All 29 images omit srcset; 20 are lazy-loaded.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Add srcset/sizes and prioritize the actual LCP image without modifying originals until approved.
findings.requiredDecision: Approve an image-delivery implementation and derivative asset policy.
findings.title: Responsive image delivery is absent

findings.finding: The isolated answer contract exists, but concise verified answer passages and source attribution are not deployed.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Add visible, factual answer passages; do not create hidden AEO text.
findings.requiredDecision: Approve visible content integration and source wording.
findings.title: Answer and entity evidence is not yet integrated

findings.finding: The document declares English while Greek/local query coverage is planned; no alternate URL set exists.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Generate hreflang only after canonical URLs and content parity are verified.
findings.requiredDecision: Choose English-only, Greek-only, or equivalent bilingual URLs.
findings.title: Language strategy is unresolved

findings.finding: The item is marked COMING SOON while an ordering action remains visible; it is blocked from structured data.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Keep the item excluded from schema until the contradiction is resolved.
findings.title: Big Tokyo status is contradictory

findings.finding: The data contracts contain zero authorized external observations.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Collect evidence with dates and provenance before making rank or review claims.
findings.requiredDecision: Authorize named accounts or an approved manual evidence process.
findings.title: GBP, citation, review, and Local Pack baselines lack live observations

findings.finding: Full-page desktop and mobile captures show large blank regions because .reveal elements are observed at app.js lines 6 and 65 while hidden by CSS near line 4204.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Ensure meaningful content is visible by default or becomes visible without requiring synthetic scroll while preserving approved motion.
findings.requiredDecision: Approve a no-JavaScript, renderer, and reduced-motion visibility fallback.
findings.title: Below-the-fold reveal content is hidden until scroll intersection

findings.finding: Placeholder legal copy is present at line 1106.
findings.requiredDecision: Provide approved legal and privacy text.
findings.title: Legal copy remains a placeholder

findings.finding: No GSC, GA4, GBP, Bing, or rank-tracking account activity was authorized.
findings.recommendedProductionChange: Activate adapters independently with least privilege and cost limits.
findings.requiredDecision: Authorize specific accounts and privacy-safe event collection.
findings.title: Production search measurement is not connected

limitations: No public production URL was verified.
No live SERP, backlink, Maps, review, PageSpeed, CrUX, Search Console, or analytics data was collected.
Browser measurements are synthetic loopback laboratory observations, not field data.
No production metadata, content, schema, crawler file, image, or runtime code was changed.
scope: Single-page local restaurant website; filesystem source plus isolated contracts and loopback lab only.

scores.scoreBasis: Offline audit rubric; not a ranking prediction and not field CWV.
